name: UAV airframe (MQ-25-class, carrier-based)
label: UAV
description: Generic carrier-based uncrewed aircraft. Notional; not a model of any real program's internals.

name: Ground / ship control station
label: GCS
description: Operator console and mission planning aboard the carrier.

name: C2 servers + mission data store
label: C2 / MISSION DATA
description: Shore-side operations center hosting C2 services and mission data.

name: GNSS constellation
label: GNSS
description: Positioning source. Shared/civil infrastructure, so neutral affiliation.

name: Software / firmware supply chain
label: SW SUPPLY CHAIN
description: Build → sign → deliver → deploy pipeline for flight software and firmware.

name: Maintenance terminal
label: MAINTENANCE
description: Credentialed maintenance access to the aircraft and GCS; loads software updates.

name: Adversary EW jammer
label: JAMMER
description: Ground or airborne RF jammer targeting C2 and GNSS links.

name: Adversary GNSS spoofer
label: SPOOFER
description: Transmits counterfeit GNSS signals to pull the UAV's navigation solution.

name: Adversary cyber operator
label: CYBER OP
description: Remote operator targeting the supply chain, credentials, GCS, and C2 networks.
